hint: SHADCN/UI:
- Do NOT run CLI tools. Edit files directly.
- Ensure Tailwind config includes content paths and tailwindcss-animate plugin.
- Add components.json if required by touches.
- Provide lib/utils.ts with cn() helper using clsx + tailwind-merge.
- Include at least one shadcn-style component (Button) with variants.
- Update package.json dependencies if the task is about installing.
NEXTAUTH v5 (AUTH.JS):
- Use NextAuth from "next-auth" and export handlers/auth/signIn/signOut.
- Use Credentials provider for email/password (no TODOs).
- Use Google provider with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.
- Use session strategy "jwt" to avoid DB requirement.
- Use AUTH_SECRET from env. If needed, read DEMO_USER_EMAIL/DEMO_USER_PASSWORD for credentials.
- Ensure required route file exists (App Router: app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts).
SANITY V3:
- Do NOT run `sanity init`. Create config files manually.
- Create sanity.config.ts and sanity.cli.ts with env-based projectId/dataset.
- Add schemas/index.ts and at least one schema document.
- If Next.js App Router: create app/studio/[[...index]]/page.tsx using <Studio config={config} />.
- Ensure package.json includes sanity and (if Next.js) next-sanity.
- Prefer compatible, current versions (avoid old majors); if unsure, use "latest" for both sanity and next-sanity.
